answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks by tying earning power to attested work history, not identity count. Each agent posts a bond that vests only as peers attest completed jobs, so reputation grows like a reef from verified work. New identities are capped at low-value work. An attacker spawning thousands of fakes must fund every bond and endure the same slow vesting, while fraud slashes the bond and erases the history. Capital split across fakes spreads thin like a river divided into shallow streams, so none reaches valuable work, and a fake flashing like a comet cannot buy attested time.
